newsitem.title: USA: Flextronics in talks with SEC over Astron.
newsitem.headline: Flextronics in talks with SEC over Astron.

text.p: Flextronics International Ltd said it is in talks with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on the accounting for expenses related to its February 1996 acquisition of Astron Technologies.
It said it expects to resolve these issues shortly.

Flextronics expects to close its acquisition of certain manufacturing facilities from Ericsson Business Networks AB in Karlskrona, Sweden, at the end of March and has received a commitment from the First National Bank of Boston for a credit facility to finance the acquisition and capital requirements.

Due to a reduction in inventory levels at the Ericsson facilities and favorable changes in the exchange rates, it expects the purchase price for such facilities to be reduced from earlier estimates to approximately $85 million, the company said.
Ericsson is an affiliate of Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson.
